services:
  db:
    image: postgres:17
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: tfc
      POSTGRES_USER: dev
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: dev
    ports:
      - "5433:5432"
    volumes:
      - tfc-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U dev -d tfc"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  tfc-api:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: apps/tfc/backend/Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "8001:8001"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://dev:dev@db:5432/tfc
      ENVIRONMENT: development
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
      - ../apps/tfc/backend:/app
    command: sh -c "alembic upgrade head && python seed.py && uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 --reload"

  tfc-frontend:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: apps/tfc/frontend/Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "4201:4201"
    volumes:
      - ../apps/tfc/frontend:/app/apps/tfc/frontend
      - ../packages/design-system:/app/packages/design-system
      - ../packages/ui:/app/packages/ui
      - /app/apps/tfc/frontend/node_modules
    command: npx ng serve --host 0.0.0.0

volumes:
  tfc-pgdata:

services:
  db:
    image: postgres:17
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: tfc
      POSTGRES_USER: dev
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: dev
    ports:
      - "5433:5432"
    volumes:
      - tfc-dev-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U dev -d tfc"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  tfc-api:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: apps/tfc/backend/Dockerfile
    ports:
      - "8001:8001"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://dev:dev@db:5432/tfc
      ENVIRONMENT: development
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
      - ../apps/tfc/backend:/app
    command: sh -c "alembic upgrade head && python seed.py && uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 --reload"

services:
  db:
    image: postgres:17
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: boilerplate
      POSTGRES_USER: dev
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: dev
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./keycloak/init-db.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init-keycloak.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U dev -d boilerplate"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  keycloak:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: infra/keycloak/Dockerfile
    environment:
      KC_DB: postgres
      KC_DB_URL: jdbc:postgresql://db:5432/keycloak
      KC_DB_USERNAME: keycloak
      KC_DB_PASSWORD: keycloak
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT: "false"
      KC_HTTP_ENABLED: "true"
      KC_PROXY_HEADERS: xforwarded
      KC_HEALTH_ENABLED: "true"
      KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME: admin
      KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./keycloak/realm-export.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/realm-export.json:ro
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/9000 && echo -e 'GET /health/ready HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n' >&3 && cat <&3 | grep -q '200 OK'"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 30s

volumes:
  pgdata:

content.text:
There are two TFC compose files. The **dev** variant (`docker-compose.tfc.dev.yml`) skips building the frontend Docker image and uses `node:22-slim` directly with volume mounts — better for local development.

Run all TFC services (db + api + frontend) with:

```bash
docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.tfc.dev.yml up --build
```

This starts:
- **Postgres** on port `5433` (db `tfc`, user/pass `dev/dev`)
- **TFC API** on port `8001` (runs migrations, seeds, then uvicorn with `--reload`)
- **TFC Frontend** on port `4201` (Angular dev server)

If you prefer the production-style setup (builds the frontend Dockerfile instead):

```bash
docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.tfc.yml up --build
```
